schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Exact pins everywhere (pnpm-workspace.yaml's saveExact, TECH-SPEC §1.2 / §16) -- Renovate must never propose a semver range, only an exact-version bump.
Group the workspace's own internal packages together -- they always move in lockstep (pnpm workspace:* protocol) and Renovate should never see them as independent third-party updates.

Runtime/dev toolchain pins with an operational blast radius beyond a normal patch bump (Node major, Postgres major, pnpm) -- reviewed by hand against TECH-SPEC §1.2's pinned-versions table, never auto-merged.
Docker base images (Dockerfiles pin by digest, TECH-SPEC §16) -- Renovate updates the digest comment/pin, never floats a tag.
GitHub Actions are pinned by commit SHA (.github/workflows/ci.yml) -- Renovate keeps the SHA pin, updating only the trailing version comment.

Lockfile-only maintenance and non-major bumps for well-established libraries can automerge once CI (the release gate profile) is green -- reduces manual toil for the highest-volume, lowest-risk update class. Every other update still needs a human to click merge.
